CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_profile()
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_id uuid, barangay_id uuid, full_name text, role text, is_active boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.barangay_id,
        p.full_name,
        p.role,
        p.is_active
    FROM qralalay.profiles p
    JOIN qralalay.barangays b
        ON b.id = p.barangay_id
    WHERE p.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      AND p.is_active = true
      AND b.is_active = true;
$function$
